review_scope: Concept/model sheet only; no sprite, moveset, animation, SMS conversion or ROM approval.

source_evidence.role: owner-approved identity, face, palette, proportions and style reference

references.role: project character identity and game-source equipment inventory

observed_defects: The previous independent review found residual ambiguity in the cane-arm attachment and competition between the violet effect and boomerang silhouette. The v4 revision explicitly places the cane arm in front of the torso and reduces ambiguity; this primary defect still needs independent confirmation.
The GDD and combat proposal/source-guide terms differ for source-game inventory. The panel marks those objects as source-game references with terminology open; it is not a fan-game moveset approval.
revision_notes: The signature pose was revised to show the cane-holding arm visibly in front of the torso and the throwing arm directed toward a larger, clearly separated steel boomerang.
Cane, rapier and steel boomerang are grouped as project concept gear. Knife, hammer, axe, pistol, bomb and stake are grouped as source-game references with open inventory terms.
Technical-card body copy was refined into concise, readable English. The late-19th-century London clothing, palette, face, profile pose, scale and visual language were retained.

document_and_layout.note: Front, profile, back, face detail and signature pose share the pale cream sheet with 7.5H ruler and separated concept/source equipment groups.

style_reference_application.note: Producer inspection sees the established CPS2-Alpha-Cel concept language; independent comparison to approved v2 remains required.

lineart_and_contours.note: Contours read cleanly at full-sheet size without visible grain or detached pixels; independent inspection remains open.

morphology_and_biotype.note: Tall, lean human ectomorph proportions and the 7.5H guide remain consistent with approved v2.

shading_and_palette.note: Blue/cyan/teal, white, gray, burgundy and brown/brass dominate; violet remains associated with the occult boomerang effect.

relative_scale_and_baseline.note: Front/profile/back share a visible common baseline and retain the 7.5H scale ruler.

neutral_background.note: Clean pale-cream background without a scene or texture.

face_and_identity_continuity.note: Gray-brown hair, round brass spectacles, intelligent face, and fully human identity remain consistent with approved v2.

costume_and_materials.note: Frock-coat tails/lapels, waistcoat, high collar, burgundy cravat, tailored trousers and leather boots now read as late-19th-century London attire across the turnaround.

equipment_and_weapon_continuity.note: Independent review confirms the blunt walking cane, separate rapier and steel boomerang have distinct silhouettes and readable labels. Source-game items remain reference-only; unresolved document terminology does not imply a fan-game moveset.

cross_view_consistency.note: Front/profile/back retain one garment family, palette, scale and human identity; independent continuity check remains open.

legibility_and_crop_integrity.note: Candidate status, weapon labels and concise technical-card text are readable at the saved full-sheet resolution; no key object touches the page edge.

human_traits_and_unapproved_details.note: No fangs, wings, transformation or other monster traits are visible.

artist_reference_and_scope.note: Bengus remains a contextual CPS2/Street Fighter Alpha art reference, not a sole-authorship claim.

distinctive_style_signature.note: Expressive fighting-game face planes, graphic silhouette and energetic action staging are retained.

pose_anatomy_and_joint_continuity.note: Independent reviewer confirms the cane arm is in front of the torso with a visible shoulder-to-hand chain and the throwing arm is separate and anatomically coherent.

visual_cohesion_and_distinction.note: Independent review confirms face, late-Victorian clothing, palette, scale, orthographic views and action rendering remain coherent with approved v2.

owner_approval.scope: Concept/model-sheet reference only; no sprites, moveset, animation, SMS conversion, integration or ROM approval.
